title: India rejects US lawmaker Pramila Jayapal’s remarks on voter roll revision as ‘interference in fellow democracy’
caption:
🇮🇳 BREAKING: India rejects US lawmaker Pramila Jayapal’s remarks on voter roll revision as ‘interference in fellow democracy’

India rejected US Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal’s criticism of the voter roll revision, calling her remarks “unwarranted and uninformed”.
